title: Frammer AI launches live sports platform with Astro Malaysia as first customer
summary: Frammer AI launches its live sports platform with Astro Malaysia, turning match footage into social media clips in under 30 seconds.
llm_summary: Frammer AI has unveiled a new live‑sports platform that automatically transforms match footage into short, share‑ready clips in under 30 seconds. Its first client, Astro Malaysia, will use the service to generate real‑time highlights for social‑media distribution, showcasing how AI can speed up content creation and boost fan engagement.
